probes.name: full-attention input per-row
probes.conclusion: Per-row input/RMSNorm does not repair the native c6 no-rowchunk divergence.

probes.name: full-attention scratch per-row
probes.conclusion: Whole-layer c1-like scratch fallback is correctness-worse and too slow.

probes.name: full-attention context per-row only
probes.conclusion: Per-row context replay does not repair the native c6 no-rowchunk divergence.

probes.name: full-attention KV append per-row
probes.conclusion: Append mechanics alone are not the repair.

probes.name: rowchunk layers 3,7,11,15, short full model
probes.conclusion: Early rowchunks are enough for the short 16-token generated-token probe, but the retained 128-token gate still needs 3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31.

decision.retain_default: Keep the existing generated-token-green selected full-attention rowchunk bridge for rows=6.
decision.next_step: Make staged full-attention substage diagnostics work with selected-c1 MoE, because the existing staged diagnostic path requires grouped MoE scratch and cannot test the server-visible c6 bridge.
